common.tagline: Interactive fiction RPG for Chinese-language readers

hero.title: Be the protagonist of your own story
hero.subtitle: AI designs each story for you, remembers every choice, and gives every NPC a real personality that won't bend to you.

memory.title: The AI actually remembers
memory.body: 4-layer memory system: recent + summary + semantic search + character files. Even after 100 hours, the AI remembers everything.

adaptive.title: UI adapts to every story
adaptive.body: Romance gets affection rings, D&D gets HP/MP bars, NBA gets player stats. AI designs UI per story.

integrity.title: NPCs have real souls
integrity.body: Every character has personality, red lines, motivations. They won't break character to please you.
